rationale: Freeze and run bounded targeted executable verification for the double-signed axis-1 candidate. The candidate makes projection freshness depend on the canonical active-semantic-set inputs, surfaces freshness, adjudication, and branch-selection state orthogonally, and preserves contested and operational-stale boundaries without auto-rebuild or branch selection.
rollback_triggers: candidate changed-path budget exceeds the three double-signed paths
deployed Skill or frozen authority changes without a separate decision
D0 difference is not reproduced because deployed is not not-stale or candidate is not stale
deployed or frozen-candidate tree hash changes between pre-run and post-run checks
an existing content-addressed target is not both canonically matching and physically free of ephemera
rollback attempts to delete a reused artifact for which candidate-freeze returned created=false
